at-0001.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0001.content: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using the established codes: "invalid_state" for wrong invoice status, "invalid_quantity" for bad quantities, "negative_amount" for negative money. Match the message style f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}" used in issue_invoice and payments.authorize.

at-0002.title: Normalize money with round_money before validating
at-0002.content: Always pass incoming monetary values through ledgerly.money.round_money (and compare against ZERO) before storing them on models; never store raw floats or unrounded Decimals. round_money also raises BillingError("float_amount") for NaN/invalid input.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0003.title: Reject bools when validating integer fields
at-0003.content: When validating an int parameter, exclude bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the isinstance(x, int) check, since True/False are ints in Python and would otherwise pass quantity validation.

at-0004.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0004.content: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

at-0005.title: Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0005.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation, by scanning `ledgerly.audit.events(<event>)` for a matching key and returning the original result; include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` call. Introduced after double-refund incident INC-204.
